metas.name: Womb
metas.description: Out 2 Mar 2025 — Trapped in a remote hunting cabin, a pregnant recovering addict battles to escape the clutches of a deranged hunter obsessed with abducting her full term fetus.

metas.name: Charlotte
metas.description: Out 1 Mar 2025 — In the dead of night, Charlotte, a young girl, appears at Roy’s doorstep, fleeing her abusive father. Despite having had a few too many drinks, Roy reluctantly offers her shelter for the night. What begins as a simple act of kindness soon evolves into a complex relationship as Charlotte’s stay extends beyond a single evening. As the days pass and her trust in Roy deepens, tension mounts, leaving the audience to question the true nature of their connection. With each startling revelation, the line between protector and predator blurs, forcing us to wonder whether either of them is who they seem.

metas.name: Animale
metas.description: Out 28 Feb 2025 — Camargue, France - Nejma trains hard to win the local bullfighting competition. When she is mauled after a celebration, she starts to notice disturbing changes. News of a rogue bull on the loose terrifies the community, killing young men.

metas.name: Fight or Flight
metas.description: Out 28 Feb 2025 — A mercenary takes on the job of tracking down a target on a plane but must protect that target when they're surrounded by people trying to kill both of them.

metas.name: Contraataque AKA Counterstrike
metas.description: Out 28 Feb 2025 — When a hostage rescue mission creates a new enemy, Capt. Guerrero and his elite soldiers must face an ambush by a criminal group.

metas.name: Squad 36
metas.description: Out 28 Feb 2025 — Forced out of his elite unit, a troubled cop launches his own rogue investigation when mysterious killings claim the lives of his former colleagues.

metas.name: Uppercut
metas.description: Out 28 Feb 2025 — When Elliott, a tough ex-boxing champion, accepts the challenge to train Toni, the two mismatched characters form an unlikely alliance. Their sparring and Elliott's keen insights show the resilient young fighter that real strength comes from the challenges you overcome when life throws its biggest punches your way.

metas.name: Cold Wallet
metas.description: Out 28 Feb 2025 — After losing everything in a cryptocurrency scam, a ragtag team of Redditors attempt to kidnap the kingpin who screwed them over.

metas.name: Demon City
metas.description: Out 27 Feb 2025 — Framed for his family's murder and left for dead, an ex-hitman will stop at nothing to exact revenge on the masked "demons" who have taken over his city.

metas.name: A Copenhagen Love Story
metas.description: Out 26 Feb 2025 — After author Mia finds love with single father Emil, their happiness is put to the test as they undergo fertility treatments to have kids of their own.

metas.name: A Complete Unknown
metas.description: Out 25 Feb 2025 — New York, early 1960s. Against the backdrop of a vibrant music scene and tumultuous cultural upheaval, an enigmatic 19-year-old from Minnesota arrives in the West Village with his guitar and revolutionary talent, destined to change the course of American music.

metas.name: Presence
metas.description: Out 25 Feb 2025 — A couple and their children move into a seemingly normal suburban home. When strange events occur, they begin to believe there is something else in the house with them. The presence is about to disrupt their lives in unimaginable ways.

metas.name: Love Hurts
metas.description: Out 25 Feb 2025 — A realtor is pulled back into the life he left behind after his former partner-in-crime resurfaces with an ominous message. With his crime-lord brother also on his trail, he must confront his past and the history he never fully buried.

metas.name: One Night in Tokyo
metas.description: Out 24 Feb 2025 — Betrayal spawns an unexpected night through the streets of Tokyo for two strangers left questioning the meaning of life and love.

metas.name: Trigger Happy
metas.description: Out 24 Feb 2025 — A repressed husband attempts to murder his bread-winning wife for her life insurance policy in this madcap, 1950s-inspired satire.

metas.name: Challenger
metas.description: Out 24 Feb 2025 — An amateur boxer gets his shot at a professional career.

metas.name: Everyone Is Going to Die
metas.description: Out 21 Feb 2025 — On his daughter's birthday, a wealthy father's reconciliation attempt is hijacked by two female burglars. A shakedown evolves into a lethal cat-and-mouse as hidden motives emerge, culminating in a life-altering revelation.

trailerStreams.title: Everyone Is Going to Die — trailer

metas.name: Here Now
metas.description: Out 21 Feb 2025 — Sophie is a twenty-year-old American who has lived her life in isolation, cut off from the world. While on vacation in Palermo with her sister, she meets Giulio and his group of Sicilian friends during her final 24 hours before returning to California. Eager to break free from her sheltered past, Sophie embarks on a whirlwind romance with Giulio.

metas.name: Old Guy
metas.description: Out 21 Feb 2025 — Stuck at a dead end but vying for the love of spunky club manager Anata, aging contract killer Danny Dolinski is thrilled when The Company pulls him back in the field, but only to train Gen Z newcomer Wihlborg, a prodigy assassin with an attitude.

metas.name: The Bayou
metas.description: Out 21 Feb 2025 — Vacation turns disaster when Houston grad Kyle and her friends survive a plane crash in the desolate Louisiana everglades, only to discover there's something way more dangerous lurking in the shallows.

metas.name: Millers in Marriage
metas.description: Out 21 Feb 2025 — Eve Miller, a former indie rock singer, struggles with her toxic marriage while growing attracted to a music journalist. Her sister Maggie, a bestselling author, faces marital discord as her career overshadows her husband's.

metas.name: Exile
metas.description: Out 20 Feb 2025 — Just prior to his release from prison, Ted Evans receives a threat from the man whose family he killed in a DUI - 'if you make contact with your family, I'll kill them'. Believing that the danger is real, Ted exiles himself to a reclusive life to protect his family. However, Ted's wife Sara knows the threat is merely a manifestation of her husband's profound guilt. Determined to rebuild their family, Sara tracks Ted down to confront him with hard evidence that the threat is imagined. But she has no idea just how unhinged he has become - or how real the threat may be.

metas.name: Inhabitants
metas.description: Out 18 Feb 2025 — A young woman with new age beliefs moves in with her lapsed Catholic boyfriend - only to discover that they’re being haunted by the vengeful ghost of his childhood youth minister.

metas.name: Katie's Mom
metas.description: Out 18 Feb 2025 — A recent divorcee's holiday celebration with her adult children derails when she falls for her daughter's charming new boyfriend. A comedy influenced by "The Graduate," told from the perspective of a protagonist inspired by Mrs. Robinson.

metas.name: Jazzy
metas.description: Out 18 Feb 2025 — Jazzy navigates the space between childhood and young adulthood. When her best friend moves away, Jazzy experiences both a sense of loss and her first inkling of independence.

metas.name: Valiant One
metas.description: Out 18 Feb 2025 — With tensions between North and South Korea, a US helicopter crashes on the North side. The survivors must work together to protect a civilian tech specialist and find their way out without the help of US military support.

metas.name: The Brutalist
metas.description: Out 18 Feb 2025 — When an innovative modern architect flees post-war Europe, he is given the opportunity to rebuild his legacy. Set during the dawn of the modern United States (in Pennsylvania), his wife joins him, and their lives are forever changed by a demanding, wealthy patron.

metas.name: Companion
metas.description: Out 18 Feb 2025 — During a weekend getaway at a secluded lakeside estate, a group of friends finds themselves entangled in a web of secrets, deception, and advanced technology. As tensions rise and loyalties are tested, they uncover unsettling truths about themselves and the world around them.

metas.name: Love Me
metas.description: Out 18 Feb 2025 — In a story that spans billions of years, a buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity’s extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

metas.name: The Last Showgirl
metas.description: Out 18 Feb 2025 — When the glittering Las Vegas revue she has headlined for decades announces it will soon close, a glamorous showgirl must reconcile with the decisions she’s made and the community she has built as she plans her next act.

metas.name: We Kill Them All
metas.description: Out 17 Feb 2025 — A young woman travels to a secluded resort where her estranged and criminal father seeks to mend their relationship. Upon her arrival, she and her girlfriend are confronted by dangerous men from her father's past and must fight for their lives.

metas.name: Way Home
metas.description: Out 17 Feb 2025 — How far are you willing to go to save the people you love? This is the question Christian is forced to answer when he is smuggled into Syria in a desperate search for his son Adam. It's a deadly and soul-searching journey into a brutal, war-torn country. Gradually, Christian realises that he must be willing to sacrifice everything he believes in to be reunited with his son.

metas.name: River of Blood
metas.description: Out 17 Feb 2025 — Four kayakers take the wrong river into a jungle inhabited by a tribe of merciless cannibals.

metas.name: Inheritance
metas.description: Out 14 Feb 2025 — When Maya learns her father Sam was once a spy, she suddenly finds herself at the center of an international conspiracy. As she seeks answers, Maya herself becomes a target and must quickly learn the skills of her father.

metas.name: The Dead Thing
metas.description: Out 14 Feb 2025 — A young woman lost in a series of meaningless connections falls in love with a charismatic and sensitive man, who hides a dark secret that turns her affair into a dangerous obsession.

metas.name: Flight Risk
metas.description: Out 14 Feb 2025 — A pilot transports a U.S. Marshal accompanying a government witness to a trial in New York. As they cross the Alaskan wilderness, tensions soar and trust is tested, as not everyone on board is who they seem.

metas.name: The Gorge
metas.description: Out 14 Feb 2025 — Two highly trained operatives grow close from a distance after being sent to guard opposite sides of a mysterious gorge. When an evil below emerges, they must work together to survive what lies within.

metas.name: L'Amour ouf AKA Beating Hearts
metas.description: Out 13 Feb 2025 — Local rebellious teenager Clotaire falls for his schoolmate Jackie, but gang violence leads him to a darker destructive path. After years apart, the star-crossed lovers discover that every path they've taken leads them back together.

trailerStreams.title: L'Amour ouf AKA Beating Hearts — trailer

metas.name: My Fault: London
metas.description: Out 13 Feb 2025 — 18-year-old Noah moves from America to London, with her mother who's recently fallen in love with William, a wealthy British businessman. Noah meets William’s son, bad-boy Nick, and soon discovers there is an attraction between them neither can avoid. As Noah spends the summer adjusting to her new life, her devastating past will catch up with her while falling in love for the first time.

metas.name: Broken Rage
metas.description: Out 13 Feb 2025 — A seemingly unremarkable man called “Mouse” is caught by the police. In exchange for his freedom, he goes undercover, infiltrates a drug ring, and arranges a fake deal, but an unexpected turn of events occurs.

metas.name: La Dolce Villa
metas.description: Out 13 Feb 2025 — When his daughter decides to buy a crumbling Tuscan villa, Eric rushes to Italy to talk her out of it — and instead finds beauty, romance and new purpose.

metas.name: Are You There?
metas.description: Out 12 Feb 2025 — When paranormal psychology student Rosa Gonzalez lights a summoning ritual candle, it ignites a life and death game of twenty questions. As the candle melts down, so does her chance of survival. She discovers some questions are best left unanswered.

metas.name: La infiltrada AKA Undercover
metas.description: Out 12 Feb 2025 — Basque Country, Spain, late nineties. A young policewoman manages to infiltrate the ruthless terrorist gang ETA.

metas.name: Honeymoon Crasher
metas.description: Out 12 Feb 2025 — When his fiancée dumps him at the altar for her ex, a young man is left with no alternative but to go on his romantic honeymoon with his mother.

metas.name: One of Them Days
metas.description: Out 11 Feb 2025 — Best friends and roommates Dreux and Alyssa are about to have One of Them Days. When they discover Alyssa’s boyfriend has blown their rent money, the duo finds themselves going to extremes in a comical race against the clock to avoid eviction and keep their friendship intact.

metas.name: Nickel Boys
metas.description: Out 11 Feb 2025 — Chronicles the powerful friendship between two young Black teenagers navigating the harrowing trials of reform school together in Florida.

metas.name: El llanto AKA The Wailing
metas.description: Out 9 Feb 2025 — Andrea, in search of her biological family, feels stalked by an invisible threat. Other women before them have suffered the same fate. Twenty years earlier, on the other side of the world, Camille, fascinated by Marie, tries to warn her of a threat hanging over her.

trailerStreams.title: El llanto AKA The Wailing — trailer

metas.name: Parthenope
metas.description: Out 6 Feb 2025 — Parthenope, born in the sea near Naples in 1950, is beautiful, enigmatic, and intelligent. She is shamelessly courted by many. However, beauty comes at a cost.

metas.name: Drained
metas.description: Out 5 Feb 2025 — Unemployed artist Thomas is captivated by alluring Rhea, who conceals her vampire nature. Their intense affair takes a sinister turn as Thomas becomes gravely ill.

metas.name: Persona
metas.description: Out 5 Feb 2025 — A woman wakes up locked in a house, injured with no memory. She's terrified and a little relieved to find a woman bound in another room. These two strangers must work together to figure out what's really going on before the door is unlocked.

metas.name: The Graduates
metas.description: Out 4 Feb 2025 — A year after her boyfriend dies from gun violence, a young woman prepares to graduate high school as she navigates an uncertain future alongside a community that is searching for ways to heal.

metas.name: Wolf Man
metas.description: Out 4 Feb 2025 — With his marriage fraying, Blake persuades his wife Charlotte to take a break from the city and visit his remote childhood home in rural Oregon. As they arrive at the farmhouse in the dead of night, they're attacked by an unseen animal and barricade themselves inside the home as the creature prowls the perimeter. But as the night stretches on, Blake begins to behave strangely, transforming into something unrecognizable.

metas.name: Wish You Were Here
metas.description: Out 4 Feb 2025 — Charlotte finds herself in a rut, searching for a spark that seems just out of reach. After she has a whirlwind night of romance and imagining a future with a man named Adam, he ghosts her. When Charlotte finally discovers that Adam is terminally ill, she helps him spend his last days living life to the fullest.

metas.name: September 5
metas.description: Out 4 Feb 2025 — During the 1972 Munich Olympics, an American sports broadcasting crew finds itself thrust into covering the hostage crisis involving Israeli athletes.

metas.name: The Death That Awaits
metas.description: Out 3 Feb 2025 — A drifter searching for answers to a mystery from her past takes on a job looking after a sick teen who is undergoing a mysterious transformation her family will do anything to stop.

metas.name: Blood Star
metas.description: Out 3 Feb 2025 — A young woman is driving through the desert alone when she is drawn into a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a psychopathic Sheriff. The chase escalates to deadly levels, and she must use her street-smarts to turn the tables against him.

metas.name: Kid Snow
metas.description: Out 1 Feb 2025 — A washed-up Irish boxer named Kid Snow is finally faced with a chance to redeem himself when he is offered a rematch against the man he fought a decade prior, on a night that changed his life forever. When he meets single mother Sunny, he is forced to contemplate a future beyond boxing.

metas.name: Like Father Like Son
metas.description: Out 31 Jan 2025 — Eli is a young man whose father waits on death row for the crime of murder in the first degree. As Eli’s life begins to fall apart, he discovers similar terrifying triggers in himself and takes extreme measures to ensure that the family’s string of savagery comes to an end.

metas.name: The Devil and the Daylong Brothers
metas.description: Out 31 Jan 2025 — Three cursed brothers seek revenge on their long-lost father who sold their souls to the Devil before their births.

trailerStreams.title: The Devil and the Daylong Brothers — trailer

metas.name: Endless Summer Syndrome
metas.description: Out 30 Jan 2025 — When the mother of two adoptees is tipped off about the possible affair her husband may be having with one of their children, her sense of duty takes a macabre turn.

metas.name: You're Cordially Invited
metas.description: Out 30 Jan 2025 — When two weddings are accidentally booked on the same day at the same venue, each bridal party is challenged with preserving their family's special moment while making the most of the unanticipated tight quarters. In a hilarious battle of determination and grit, the father of the bride and sister of the other bride chaotically go head-to-head as they stop at nothing to uphold an unforgettable celebration for their loved ones.

metas.name: Beacon
metas.description: Out 29 Jan 2025 — After an ambitious solo trip leaves her shipwrecked on a remote island, a young sailor is rescued by its lone inhabitant: a lighthouse keeper. As the walls of reality begin to vanish and the trust between them unravels, survival becomes a test of grueling proportions.

metas.name: Bone Face
metas.description: Out 29 Jan 2025 — When a masked killer slaughters several campers in a small town, a sheriff and a deputy track the murderer to a local diner where, using their investigative skills, they must discover which person in the diner is the actual killer.

metas.name: Never Have I Ever
metas.description: Out 29 Jan 2025 — Sam is already having a bad day, but an incident from Sam's youth resurfaces in ways he couldn't imagine and starts a series of events that send his life spiralling out of control, embroiling him in an escalating game of cat and mouse.

metas.name: Freelance
metas.description: Out 29 Jan 2025 — When a down-on-her luck video editor takes on a mysterious, well-paying job cutting snuff films, she is haunted by visions of the people in her videos.

metas.name: Babygirl
metas.description: Out 28 Jan 2025 — A high-powered CEO puts her career and family on the line when she begins a torrid affair with her much younger intern.

metas.name: The Fire Inside
metas.description: Out 28 Jan 2025 — Claressa Shields, a high school junior from Flint, Michigan, aided by her tough-love coach, Jason Crutchfield, pushes past all limitations to become the first American woman to win an Olympic gold medal in boxing. But even at the pinnacle of success, Claressa has to reckon with the fact that not all dreams are created equal, and the real fight has only just begun.

metas.name: Den of Thieves 2: Pantera
metas.description: Out 28 Jan 2025 — Big Nick is back on the hunt in Europe and closing in on Donnie, who is embroiled in the treacherous and unpredictable world of diamond thieves and the infamous Panther mafia, as they plot a massive heist of the world's largest diamond exchange.

metas.name: Samson
metas.description: Out 28 Jan 2025 — A recently broken up couple are forced to work together when they are kidnapped by two masked men.

metas.name: Oh, Canada
metas.description: Out 24 Jan 2025 — Famed Canadian-American leftist documentary filmmaker Leonard Fife was one of sixty thousand draft evaders and deserters who fled to Canada to avoid serving in Vietnam. Now in his late seventies, Fife is dying of cancer in Montreal and has agreed to a final interview in which he is determined to bare all his secrets at last, to demythologize his mythologized life.

metas.name: Grafted
metas.description: Out 24 Jan 2025 — When an awkward but brilliant Chinese student wins a scholarship into a prestigious New Zealand University, she finds a new way of achieving the popularity she craves one bloody body at a time.

metas.name: The Sand Castle
metas.description: Out 24 Jan 2025 — Stranded on a deserted island, a family of four scavenges for survival as their past unravels, sending them into a downward spiral of painful events.

metas.name: The Intruder
metas.description: Out 24 Jan 2025 — A young man's paranoia spirals when he becomes convinced that someone is sneaking into his home every night.

metas.name: Into the Deep
metas.description: Out 22 Jan 2025 — Divers searching for sunken treasure witness the murder of drug dealers by modern-day pirates, but a killer great white is determined not to let any of them escape its waters.

metas.name: Bonhoeffer: Pastor. Spy. Assassin
metas.description: Out 21 Jan 2025 — As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, Dietrich Bonhoeffer joins a deadly plot to assassinate Hitler, risking his faith and fate to save millions of Jews from genocide.

metas.name: Nosferatu
metas.description: Out 21 Jan 2025 — A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

metas.name: The Damned
metas.description: Out 21 Jan 2025 — A 19th-century widow has to make an impossible choice when, during an especially cruel winter, a foreign ship sinks off the coast of her Icelandic fishing village.

metas.name: The Monster Beneath Us
metas.description: Out 17 Jan 2025 — Yorkshire, 1898. A grieving woman and her son move back to the unoccupied house of her ex husband, recently found dead, but they discover that they are not alone inside the house.

metas.name: Back in Action
metas.description: Out 17 Jan 2025 — Fifteen years after vanishing from the CIA to start a family, elite spies Matt and Emily jump back into the world of espionage when their cover is blown.

metas.name: Alarum
metas.description: Out 17 Jan 2025 — Two married spies caught in the crosshairs of an international intelligence network will stop at nothing to obtain a critical asset. Joe and Lara are agents living off the grid whose quiet retreat at a winter resort is blown to shreds when members of the old guard suspect the two may have joined an elite team of rogue spies, known as Alarum.

metas.name: Filthy Animals
metas.description: Out 16 Jan 2025 — Set on Christmas Eve, the story of two outlaw misfits, Lars, a thrill-seeking drug enthusiast, and Freddy, a bodybuilder recently out of rehab, who hunt down child sexual predators.

metas.name: Unstoppable
metas.description: Out 16 Jan 2025 — With the unwavering love and support of his devoted mother Judy and the encouragement of his coaches, Anthony Robles fights through adversity to earn a spot on the Arizona State Wrestling team. But it will demand everything he has, physically and mentally, to achieve his ultimate quest to become an NCAA Champion.

metas.name: Der Heimweg AKA The Calendar Killer
metas.description: Out 16 Jan 2025 — Klara is going to die today unless she kills her husband instead. The Calendar Killer has given her that impossible choice. When Jules starts his night shift at a telephone safety helpline for lonely women on their way home, Klara's call reaches him. He soon becomes her last hope for survival and races against time to save her.

trailerStreams.title: Der Heimweg AKA The Calendar Killer — trailer

metas.name: De lydløse AKA  The Quiet Ones
metas.description: Out 14 Jan 2025 — In 2008, a group of men from Denmark and across Europe pull off the biggest heist of all time on Danish soil. Kasper, a boxer with few chances left in life, is offered the opportunity to plan the robbery by its foreign initiators.

trailerStreams.title: De lydløse AKA  The Quiet Ones — trailer

metas.name: Kraven the Hunter
metas.description: Out 14 Jan 2025 — Kraven Kravinoff's complex relationship with his ruthless gangster father, Nikolai, starts him down a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.

metas.name: Man with No Past
metas.description: Out 14 Jan 2025 — Waking up in an unfamiliar city, a man with no memory must confront the mysteries of his own identity. However, his desperate search to uncover the past pits him against a powerful enemy, leading to a showdown that ultimately reveals the truth.

metas.name: Bloody Axe Wound
metas.description: Out 14 Jan 2025 — Abbie Bladecut is a teenager torn between the macabre traditions of her family’s bloody trade and the tender stirrings of her first crush. In the small town of Clover Falls, Abbie’s father Roger has built an infamous legacy by capturing real-life killings on tape and selling them to eager customers, but as Abbie delves deeper into the grisly family business, she begins to wonder if it’s time to take the family tradition in a new direction.

metas.name: Singing in My Sleep
metas.description: Out 13 Jan 2025 — A brilliant teenage songwriter is stuck living in the shadow of her deceased Dad's music legacy when the 20-year anniversary of his debut album forces her to face his abandonment.

metas.name: The Room Next Door
metas.description: Out 12 Jan 2025 — Ingrid and Martha were close friends in their youth, when they worked together at the same magazine. Ingrid went on to become an autofiction novelist while Martha became a war reporter, and they were separated by the circumstances of life. After years of being out of touch, they meet again in an extreme but strangely sweet situation.

metas.name: Laws of Man
metas.description: Out 12 Jan 2025 — A pair of U.S. marshals search for a wanted murderer in Nevada at the height of the Cold War and encounter more than they bargained for.

metas.name: Black Diamond
metas.description: Out 11 Jan 2025 — Follows a young woman whose idyllic life with her hedge funder boyfriend turns it into a deadly triangle of lust, obsession and murder after meeting a local cowboy handyman.

metas.name: Le Jardinier AKA The Gardener
metas.description: Out 10 Jan 2025 — Every year the Prime Minister has a list of all kinds of troublemakers eliminated in the name of the famous Reason of State. Serge Shuster, Special Adviser to the President of the Republic, finds himself on this list, better known as the Matignon List.  Condemned to certain death and at the heart of an implacable plot and a state secret that also put his family in danger, Serge, his wife and children have only one hope left - their gardener, Léo, who hates it when « slugs » invade his garden... Especially those that want to kill innocent families.

trailerStreams.title: Le Jardinier AKA The Gardener — trailer

metas.name: Ad Vitam
metas.description: Out 10 Jan 2025 — When he and his pregnant wife are attacked in their home, a former elite agent becomes trapped in a deadly manhunt tied to his own painful past.

metas.name: Get Away
metas.description: Out 10 Jan 2025 — A family's vacation to a remote getaway takes an unexpected turn when they discover the present-day implications of the island's cannibalistic past.

metas.name: The Man in the White Van
metas.description: Out 7 Jan 2025 — In early 1970s Florida, an ominous white van stalks young women. A teenage girl is the latest victim, but this one won't stay a victim.

trailerStreams.title: The Man in the White Van — trailer

metas.name: He Ain't Heavy
metas.description: Out 3 Jan 2025 — A desperate woman kidnaps and enforces rehab on her violent brother in a last-ditch effort to save their lives.

metas.name: Mica è Colpa Mia AKA  The Love Scam
metas.description: Out 1 Jan 2025 — Drowning in debt, two brothers concoct a plan to scam a wealthy heiress and save their home in Naples — but unexpected love soon complicates the scheme.

metas.name: Number 24
metas.description: Netflix · Out 1 Jan 2025 — On the brink of the Second World War, a young Norwegian man's drive to resist the Nazis sets a new course for his future – and the future of his country.
